limits: One sweep per configuration on a shared desktop; small gaps are not statistical evidence.
FP16/BF16 retain the frontend and BatchNorm in FP32. FP16 uses a dtype-safe attention mask in an isolated process.
INT8 uses a different runtime (ONNX/TensorRT, INT8 QDQ MatMul with FP16 fallback) and FP32 CPU frontend; not an isolated precision comparison.
INT8 is a calibration pilot with 32 training prefixes; its 0.25 score drift needs quality evaluation before selection.
Numerical smoke checks use four prefixes of one real audio clip; they do not establish full benchmark parity.

onnx_validation.scope: 4 real prefixes; confirms export numerics and realized INT8 engine formats, not overall model quality

nsight_kernel_verification.scope: Separate one-inference diagnostic trace; these timings are not used for HTTP latency numbers.
